nyapp: New York App Week is a community-led week for the app economy, anchored by RevenueCat. It covers app growth, subscriptions, monetization and consumer and AI apps, with workshops, dinners, a hackathon and the Shippies awards, plus RevenueCat's App Growth Annual on Oct 21.
osai: Open Source AI Week is a decentralized run of independently organized Bay Area events on open models and tools, kicked off by Hugging Face on Oct 16. It includes PyTorch Conference North America (Oct 20-21) and AGNTCon and MCPCon North America (Oct 22-23).
gtc: NVIDIA GTC Berlin is NVIDIA's flagship European AI conference, covering the full AI stack from chips and infrastructure to models and applications. Workshops are Oct 20, Jensen Huang's keynote is Oct 21 at Tempodrom, and the conference runs Oct 21-22 at STATION-Berlin.
mcw: Munich Climate Week is the first edition of an open forum on the sustainable transformation of business and society, bringing together business, science, politics and civil society. TÜV SÜD and the Strascheg Center for Entrepreneurship are founding partners.
tough: Tough Tech Week is The Engine's week of panels, pitches and workshops on science and engineering breakthroughs turning into real-world companies in climate, health and advanced systems, across Massachusetts.
f1atx: F1 Austin is the Formula 1 United States Grand Prix weekend at Circuit of the Americas (COTA), when Austin fills with brand activations, parties and dinners around the race.
atw: Austin Tech Week is Austin's annual five-day tech and startup week, run since 2011 with Capital Factory, covering founders, operators and investors from pre-seed to growth stage. It includes Startup Crawl, Pitch Day and a VC Reverse Pitch.
mxtw: Mexico Tech Week is the fourth edition of Mexico City's tech week, with 500+ events and about 30,000 attendees expected. It covers AI, biotech, robotics, space tech and materials science, with Tecnológico de Monterrey as main partner and a new Tech Town program on Oct 27-29.
seaai: Seattle AI Week is run by the Washington Technology Industry Association (WTIA). The AI Summit is on Oct 27 at Bell Harbor, an opening reception is on Oct 26, and 75+ community events follow Oct 28-30 on AI infrastructure, startups, life sciences, quantum, security and policy.
hardtech: Hard Tech Week is Utah's physical-technology week, run by 47G with Utah Tech Week, Nucleus and Silicon Slopes. It covers aerospace, defense, drones, advanced manufacturing, energy and space, with a hackathon, factory tours and the Zero Gravity Summit at the Salt Palace on Oct 28-29.
dtw: DeepTech Week TLV is Tel Aviv's deep technology week, bringing together founders, researchers and investors building in frontier science and engineering.
hkfw: Hong Kong FinTech Week x StartmeupHK is Hong Kong's flagship fintech and startup event, with about 45,000 attendees from 120+ economies expected. The main conference is Nov 2-3 at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre, with community events across Hong Kong and the Greater Bay Area.
afro: AfroTech is the annual conference for Black technologists, founders and investors, held in Houston, with talks, a career fair, a startup expo and a large circuit of related dinners and mixers.
cltw: Chile Tech Week is Santiago's tech and startup week, bringing together Chilean founders, investors and Latin American ecosystem builders.
mdtw: Madrid Tech Week is the Comunidad de Madrid's tech and innovation week, now in its second edition, with about 1,200 companies and 600 experts expected.
batw: TecWeek Buenos Aires is a 12-day, multi-venue technology festival centered on BA Ferial. It covers AI, gaming, digital finance and crypto, startups and biotech, and includes SAIAConf, Deep Tech Summit, Argentina Fintech Forum and LABITCONF.
reinvent: AWS re:Invent is Amazon Web Services' annual cloud computing conference in Las Vegas, with keynotes, hundreds of technical sessions and a large circuit of partner and startup events around the Strip.
gitex: GITEX Global in Dubai is one of the world's largest technology shows, paired with Expand North Star, the startup and investor event. Both bring together enterprises, governments, startups and investors across AI, cybersecurity and deep tech.
ces: CES is the Consumer Technology Association's annual consumer electronics show in Las Vegas, covering hardware, AI, mobility, health tech and consumer products, with a large side circuit of investor and founder events.
jpm: JPM Healthcare Week is the week around the J.P. Morgan Healthcare Conference in San Francisco, the biotech, pharma and healthcare investing meeting of the year. Most deal-making happens at side events, dinners and receptions around it.
wsq: Web Summit Qatar is Web Summit's Middle East edition in Doha, bringing together founders, investors, corporates and government for a multi-day tech conference.
wef: WEF Davos is the World Economic Forum Annual Meeting in the Swiss Alps, where heads of state, CEOs and investors meet. Most business activity happens at private receptions and dinners along the Promenade.
aff: The Asian Financial Forum is Hong Kong's annual finance conference, held at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre and organized by the Hong Kong SAR Government and HKTDC. It brings together financial leaders, investors, family offices and policymakers. Yorkseed runs a delegation here.
switch: SWITCH (Singapore Week of Innovation and Technology) is Asia's innovation festival, organized by Enterprise Singapore with support from the National Research Foundation. Its flagship is the SLINGSHOT startup pitching finals, alongside keynotes, market access sessions and roundtables on AI, climate and energy, quantum, advanced materials, healthcare and biotech, and digital connectivity. The 2025 edition drew over 25,000 attendees from 100+ markets.
slush: Slush is Finland's startup conference, held at Messukeskus Helsinki on Nov 18-19 with a Day 0 founders and investor program on Nov 17. Founded in 2008, it runs matchmaking for 20,000+ scheduled meetings, the Slush 100 competition and 600+ community side events. The 2026 theme is Radical Resilience.
lisws: Web Summit is Europe's largest tech conference, held Nov 9-12, 2026 at MEO Arena and FIL in Lisbon, with 70,000+ attendees across startups, investors, corporates and media.
t49dxb: TOKEN2049 Dubai is the Middle East edition of TOKEN2049, the crypto and Web3 conference series, postponed to April 21-22, 2027 after the organizers moved it for security reasons. Side events run around it on a community Luma calendar.
